evals_reused_note: Origin ships no evals/ directory. Authored fresh from the origin SKILL.md's five modes (Recover/Audit/Verify-merged/Prevent/Retire) and its six load-bearing rules, especially the scope rule (a second clone elsewhere on disk is invisible to every in-repo command) and the merge-verification rule (commit-count and naive content checks are all unsound; only a real trial merge is reliable).
live_dependency_note: Purely local git-object-store forensics (reflog, fsck, worktrees, stashes). No live external service.
